features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance and cost.
acceptance_criteria: System generates recommendations based on data analysis.
Recommendations are actionable and prioritized.
Users can view and export recommendations.
System updates recommendations as new data is ingested.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a system to ingest pipeline execution metrics into the analysis platform.
acceptance_criteria: System can connect to the Artemis pipeline data source.
Data is ingested in real-time or near-real-time.
Data integrity is maintained during ingestion.
System handles data ingestion failures gracefully.

features.title: Stage Performance Evaluation
features.description: Implement a feature to evaluate the performance of different stages in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view performance metrics for each pipeline stage.
Performance metrics include execution time and resource usage.
System highlights stages with performance issues.
Users can filter performance data by stage.

features.title: Visualization Dashboard
features.description: Create a dashboard to visualize pipeline metrics and analysis results.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays key metrics and analysis results.
Users can customize dashboard views.
Dashboard updates in real-time with new data.
Users can share dashboard views with others.

features.title: Trend Analysis
features.description: Create a module to analyze trends in pipeline execution metrics over time.
acceptance_criteria: System can generate trend reports for specified time periods.
Users can visualize trends through graphs or charts.
Trend analysis is accurate and reflects real-time data.
Users can download trend analysis reports.

features.title: Cost Effectiveness Analysis
features.description: Develop a tool to analyze the cost effectiveness of the pipeline operations.
acceptance_criteria: System calculates cost metrics for pipeline operations.
Users can view cost effectiveness reports.
Reports include cost breakdown by stage and resource usage.
Users can identify cost-saving opportunities.
